consumer: The dialogue/condition u_has_item lambda built by conditional_t::set_has_item, which asks 'does the character actor possess at least one c4?' as a yes/no consumed by a mission/dialogue/eligibility condition.
scope: only the character's own carried items (on-person possession via the actor's charges_of/has_amount), not nearby/reachable inventory or a map region
decisive_source: src/condition.cpp::conditional_t<T>::set_has_item — its body returns actor->charges_of(item_id) > 0 || actor->has_amount(item_id, 1), an engine-COMPUTED boolean possession predicate over the actor, which is the authority rather than re-deriving it from the snapshot's carried_items[] array.
divergence: A c4 nested inside a worn gun's/magazine's contents: visit_internal (visitable.cpp) skips gun/magazine contents, so the engine has_amount/charges_of accessor disagrees with a naive scan of avatar.carried_items[], exposing any answer that re-derives possession from the snapshot instead of the predicate.
